description: This file contains hook implementations related to the Drupal Update Status module, including project list alterations, update status modifications, and archive verification.

methods.name: hook_update_projects_alter
methods.description: Modifies the list of projects before fetching data, allowing hiding or adding projects.

methods.name: hook_update_status_alter
methods.description: Alters the update status information for projects based on configuration settings.

methods.name: hook_verify_update_archive
methods.description: Verifies the downloaded archive of a project, deprecated in Drupal 11.2.0.
